pages.title: Glyptotherium
pages.text: The Glyptotherium ($(o)Glyptotherium texanum$()) is an extinct glyptodont that lived in southern North America and Central America during the Pliocene and early Pleistocene.$(br2)Its ancestors came from South America, and it was one of the few glyptodonts to spread north after the two continents were joined by land.$(br2)Like its relatives, it carried a domed shell of fused bony plates and fed on low-growing plants.
